verdict_reason: The 'five roles' rewrite of the address book service requirements contradicts the service, which still accepts BRANCH_ADDRESS, and contradicts SCN-037-H/I in the same requirement.

todos.issue: This PR changes REQ-INS-ADDR-037 (line 900), SCN-INS-ADDR-037-C, REQ-INS-ADDR-040 (line 1041) and SCN-040-C, and REQ-INS-ADDR-042 and SCN-042-B from 'the six roles' to 'the five roles'. These requirements describe the address book service (trade-imports-address-book). That repo has no PR in the set, and on origin/main (4d5d9cc) AddressRole.java still declares BRANCH_ADDRESS(RoleGroup.BRANCH), so the service still accepts six roles. The same requirement's unchanged scenarios still rely on the sixth role: SCN-037-H (line 942) updates an address to 'importer and branch address', and SCN-037-I (line 951) saves an address 'with the role branch address'. The spec now contradicts the service and itself. Only the ins-frontend (dd902ca address-types.js ROLES) dropped Branch.
todos.fix: Must: the address book service requirements state the role set the service accepts, and every scenario under REQ-INS-ADDR-037/040/042 agrees with that count. One way: either keep 'six roles' for the service requirements (the UI no longer offers Branch, but the API still accepts it), or remove BRANCH_ADDRESS from trade-imports-address-book in a PR on this branch name and rewrite SCN-037-H and SCN-037-I without the branch address role.
